names.details:
Cezā’ir-i Serendīb: Eni ve uzunı seksen fersaḫdur. Ehl-i Hind ḳavlince Ḥażret-i Ādem ‘aleyhi’s-selām ol cezīredeki ṭaġlaruñ birine inmişdür. Ekābir-i Berāhime taḥḳīḳi üzere Ḥażret-i Ādem’üñ ḳademi yiri anda henüz ma‘lūmdur. Ḥattā yetmiş ẕirā‘ uzunında maġmūs u mersūmdür. Gicede ve gündüzde ol ṭaġ üzerinde nūr gibi bir żiyā ẓāhir olur. Ba‘de-mā Ḥażret-i Ādem ol cezīreden iki adım inmişdür, didükleri iki günlik mesāfedür. Fe-lā-cerem anuñ ḥavālīsi eṣnāf-ı cevāhirle memlūdur. Ve la‘l ü elmās u yāḳūtla [69b E] müzeyyen ve ṭopṭoludur.

Islands of Serendib: Its length and width are eighty farsakhs. According to the people of India, Prophet Adam (peace be upon him) landed on one of the mountains on this island. According to the accounts of the knowledgeable Brahmans, the place where Prophet Adam set foot is still known; Also, its foot size is about seventy cubits long. A light like a luminous glow appears on that mountation during day and night. It is also said that after descending from the island, Prophet Adam took two steps and each step corresponds to a distance of one day journey for human. For this reason, the surrounding area is rich with various kinds of gems. Also, it is decorated and full with rubies, diamonds, and sapphires. (Translation provided by the creator of this entry)
names.description: Refers to the islands of Sri Lanka. The term was used to cover Sri Lanka and the small islands around it.
